mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=w.id WHERE wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' AND w.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC
SELECT FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=w.id WHERE w.id=#{id} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' AND w.status<>'DELETED'
SELECT FROM workspaces w WHERE w.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE workspaces SET name=#{workspace.name},code=#{workspace.code},description=#{workspace.description},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{workspace.id} AND status<>'DELETED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace.id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')

UPDATE workspaces SET status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status<>'DELETED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')

UPDATE workspaces SET preferences=CAST(#{preferences} AS jsonb),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')
